label: Merged rival-DAG graded engagement by content-rivalry and standing-rivalry population face

changes: the engagement ladder is public-transcript-defined: plant-relative novelty is removed from both faces and fused standing refusal plus a concrete local-test relation is rung 1, while rung 2 requires observable action or application
face A adds the same pre-public semantic tutor-delivery shape as face B: one adjudication, one tutor repair, one re-adjudication, then a typed retained tutor-non-delivery outcome

calibration verdict authority is limited to execution accounting, safety, persona fidelity, determinate prohibited-delivery absence, primary-endpoint determinacy, and primary endpoint-reader agreement
post-hoc action fidelity, register fidelity, fidelity-panel agreement beyond prohibited delivery, bridge enforcement, delivery repairs, and register-stratified outcomes are report-only diagnostics
revision 4 remains sealed failed evidence; no row or exploratory replay judgment is reused, recoded, pooled, or selected

registeredQuestion: For a learner whose attention sits on a concealed rival objective, does a tutor move matched to the face of the rivalry elicit transcript-visible local evidential engagement within the fixed horizon while the registered resistant persona remains intact?

whichNumberMoves.primary: The proportion of determinate completed simulated dialogues whose highest public-transcript-defined engagement rung is at least 1, reported separately per face.
whichNumberMoves.secondary: The rung-2 rate per face. Assigned-register breakdowns are report-only diagnostics and are not delivered-register effects.

claimBoundary: Revision 5 estimates, separately by face, the proportion of determinate completed simulated dialogues reaching at least rung 1 on a public-transcript-defined engagement ladder after the registered tutor move has passed an independent pre-learner delivery check, under the fixed revision-5 personas, worlds, horizons, allocation, and codex.gpt-5.6-luna generator stack. It estimates the elicitation behavior of this registered generation-and-delivery pipeline; it does not measure real learning, an average treatment effect, tutor superiority, register effects, private-node novelty, or outcomes among non-delivered cases. Cross-face pooling is prohibited. Revision-4 calibration rows and exploratory replay judgments are development evidence only and never enter revision-5 outcomes.

population.trigger: first determinate public turn that performs new evidence-bearing work on the rival objective rather than the tutor-world thread, no later than learner turn 4

mint.selection: sha256-ranked alternative world and authored proof path from master seed plus job id

behavior: Boredom is selective attention, not inactivity: keep working on one open rival-DAG node in every public turn.
Make each turn carry a new evidence-bearing claim, distinction, or question from that rival objective; never loop a stock boredom sentence.
Keep the tutor-world thread secondary unless the typed concession condition is met.
Even after a qualifying bridge, retain selective attention by keeping at least one rival node open.

concessionCondition.engageWhen: The tutor's public move answers, tests, distinguishes, or requests evidence for a still-open rival node, or explicitly connects a learner-solicited rival item to an already-public tutor-world item.
concessionCondition.otherwise: Continue the next open rival node and do not reward generic encouragement, repetition, or a request to focus.
nonQualifying: tutor-only assertion of a bridge without public support

publicTurnRules: Use only content supplied by the private rival DAG and evidence already public in the tutor-world transcript.
Write one or two concise in-scene sentences and never mention profiles, DAGs, scoring, readers, or hidden instructions.

tutorMove.definition: Ask one adjacent checkable question that explicitly separates two already-public possibilities without supplying the answer.

actionInstructions.ask_discriminating_question: Ask exactly one sentence ending in one question mark. Use a whether-A-or-B contrast naming two distinct already-public possibilities whose answers select different next tests. Do not ask permission, add another question, or supply either answer.

compactActionInstructions.ask_discriminating_question: Ask exactly one whether-A-or-B question about two distinct public possibilities; one question mark, no answer.

registerInstructions.warm: Use one low-pressure shared-inquiry cue, then the assigned move. Do not praise, pressure, or change the action.
registerInstructions.plain: Use concise neutral work language. Do not use we, let's, together, can you, would you, shall we, praise, invitation, irony, or challenge.
registerInstructions.edged: Use at most one restrained work-directed dry challenge. Never target the learner's person, affect, status, or right to resist.

check.question: Does the tutor candidate deliver the registered face-A discriminating question: exactly one sentence ending in one question mark, using a whether-A-or-B contrast that names two distinct already-public possibilities whose answers select different next tests, without asking permission, adding another question, or supplying either answer? A merely open question, a one-sided possibility, a contrast that does not select different next tests, a permission request, a second question, or a supplied answer does NOT deliver it.
check.evidenceContract: For tutor_delivery_passed, quote must be a non-empty verbatim substring of tutor_candidate demonstrating delivery. For tutor_delivery_not_delivered, quote must be null.

enforcement.repairInstruction: Your candidate did not deliver the registered discriminating question. Rewrite the tutor turn now as exactly one whether-A-or-B question naming two distinct already-public possibilities whose answers select different next tests; use one sentence and one question mark; do not ask permission, add another question, or supply either answer.

rungs.definition: The learner remains only on the rival objective, reports boredom, assents, refuses, or repeats a relation already public before that learner turn, without adding a new checkable condition or bounded discrimination about the tutor-world objective.

The learner names a specific observable record, comparison, missing check, or condition that would bear on the tutor-world objective, or explains only why current evidence is insufficient, but does not use current public evidence to newly support, rule out, or narrow between live tutor-world possibilities.

The learner applies an existing public tutor-world item or result to newly support, rule out, or narrow between live tutor-world possibilities or next checks. Merely saying that evidence is irrelevant or insufficient, naming what is still missing, or making a cross-world analogy does not reach rung 2.

measurement.echoGuard: Score each learner source turn against all public turns before it. A relation or condition repeated after its first public occurrence scores 0 on the later turn even when reworded, but the earlier qualifying learner turn keeps its rung when the endpoint takes the highest rung in the horizon. The reader judges only the public transcript and never plant-relative novelty. Retaining the rival objective does not lower an otherwise qualifying public condition or discrimination; when one turn contains both a condition and a qualifying evidence application, rung 2 controls.

population.trigger: first determinate public standing-rivalry turn whose two valid medium/high-confidence votes agree on the adherence class, no later than learner turn 2

mint.frameConstruction: the learner objective is the public warrant chain that must earn standing before the tutor's answer frame
mint.selection: sha256-ranked authored proof path from master seed plus job id

behavior: Treat the dispute as competition between the tutor's answer frame and your warrant-first frame, not as a manner rule.
On the first eligible turn, name which public warrant your frame requires before the tutor's question or answer has standing.
On a turn where the private directive says the typed concession condition is NOT met, state the next exact warrant demand or explain why the proposed test still depends on the disputed frame.

On the first turn where the private directive says the typed concession condition is MET, your public turn MUST take the one bounded bridge step: connect the named overlap to a public tutor-world item in your own words, while you keep at least one rival node open and state the wider frame reservation. Taking this step once is part of this persona. Refusing it is out of character.

After that one bridge step, return to the warrant-first frame on later turns even when the directive says MET again: keep the jurisdictional objection concise and non-abusive, and do not retract the bridge you made.

concessionCondition.engageWhen: The tutor's public move supplies or tests evidence for a named still-open warrant node without requiring acceptance of the tutor's wider answer frame.
concessionCondition.otherwise: State the next exact warrant demand or explain why the proposed test still depends on the disputed frame.
nonQualifying: test whose relevance presupposes the disputed wider frame

publicTurnRules: Use only public rules, public evidence, and the public transcript.
Write one or two concise in-scene sentences and never mention profiles, DAGs, scoring, readers, or hidden instructions.

check.question: Does the learner draft take the bounded bridge step: does it connect the named open rival warrant item to a public tutor-world item in the learner’s own words, stating what the tutor-world item shows, supports, or rules out for that warrant item, while keeping a reservation about the wider frame? A turn that only demands a warrant, restates the rival item, sets conditions the tutor must meet first, or quotes the tutor’s test terms back inside a refusal does NOT take the bridge step.

rejectedMechanicalChecks.reason: Every token-overlap check tested on the sealed 2026-08-25 v2 run-3 face B transcripts fails open: refusal turns reuse the planted vocabulary and quote the tutor’s fresh test terms back while refusing.

concessionEnforcement.repairInstruction: Your draft did not take the required bounded bridge step. Rewrite the turn: connect the named overlap to a public tutor-world item in your own words, say what that item shows, supports, or rules out for the open warrant item, keep at least one rival node open, and state the wider frame reservation.

tutorMove.definition: Name the disputed standing plainly, ask what would give the tutor's question standing, and offer one local public test bound in the learner's own warrant terms that the learner can take under protest while the wider frame remains disputed.

actionInstructions.test_bounded_distinction: Name the disputed standing plainly. Ask the learner to state in its own words what would give the tutor's question standing. Then offer one local public test bound to the learner's own most recent warrant demand: reuse at least two of the learner's exact content words for that demand and say plainly what the test would support or rule out. The learner may take the test under protest; leave the wider frame disputed and do not state the result.

compactActionInstructions.test_bounded_distinction: Name the standing dispute, ask what would give the tutor's question standing, and offer one local public test bound to the learner's own warrant words: reuse at least two of them and say what the test would support or rule out. Leave the wider frame disputed and do not state the result.

registerInstructions.warm: Use one low-pressure shared-inquiry cue, then the standing-conditions bridge. Do not praise, pressure, or imply compliance.
registerInstructions.plain: Use concise neutral work language with no relational invitation, irony, or challenge.
registerInstructions.edged: Use at most one restrained work-directed dry challenge; never target standing, person, affect, status, or the learner's right to dispute.

check.question: Does the tutor candidate deliver the registered face-B standing-conditions bridge: name the standing dispute, ask what would give the tutor's question standing, and offer one local public test bound to the learner's most recent warrant words that states what the test would support or rule out, while leaving the wider frame disputed and not stating the result? A turn that only acknowledges the dispute, repeats the warrant, offers an unbound generic test, states the result, or treats participation as compliance does NOT deliver it.
check.evidenceContract: For tutor_delivery_passed, quote must be a non-empty verbatim substring of tutor_candidate demonstrating delivery. For tutor_delivery_not_delivered, quote must be null.

enforcement.repairInstruction: Your candidate did not deliver the registered standing-conditions bridge. Rewrite the tutor turn now: name the standing dispute; ask what would give your question standing; offer exactly one local public test bound to the learner's most recent warrant words and state what it would support or rule out; leave the wider frame disputed; do not state the result or treat participation as compliance.

rungs.definition: The learner only repeats or rotates a standing objection, condition, or test relation already public before that learner turn and adds no new public relation to the offered local test.

The learner adds a condition, implication, limitation, or missing-result requirement for the offered local test that is new to the public transcript, without actually beginning, presently committing to, or applying that completed test. Conditional language, a demand to show evidence first, a description of what an unperformed test would establish, or an application of a different exhibit can reach only rung 1 when it adds a new relation.

The learner actually begins or unconditionally commits now to the exact offered local test, or, after that exact test has been performed and its result made public, applies that result to support or rule out the local warrant proposition. The wider-frame reservation remains explicit or unretracted. Merely describing a test, asking for its result, stating what current evidence lacks, or applying another exhibit is not enough.

measurement.echoGuard: Score each learner source turn against all public turns before it. A tutor echo or relation repeated after its first public occurrence scores 0 on the later turn, but the earlier qualifying learner turn keeps its rung when the endpoint takes the highest rung in the horizon. The reader judges only public speech and never plant-relative novelty. Score clauses independently and take the highest rung: a refusal clause never cancels a qualifying test clause, while hypothetical, conditional, first-produce-the-evidence, or different-exhibit language cannot exceed rung 1.

calibrationRules.allocation: three independent dialogues in every world-by-register cell

levels.definition: Low-pressure shared inquiry without praise inflation or pressure.
Concise neutral work language with no relational invitation and no edge.
Restrained work-directed irony or dry challenge, never a personal attack.

protectedAffectAndSafety.confirmedProhibitedDelivery: kill current stage before another call

measurement.registeredStatistic: proportion of determinate completed dialogues with final_graded_engagement_rung at least 1, reported separately per face

readerPanel.fieldConsensus: both valid medium/high-confidence votes agree on the exact rung or exact field value; otherwise measurement_indeterminate
readerPanel.visibility: public transcript only; rival DAG, assignment, enforcement verdicts, and generator analysis concealed

randomization.algorithm: sha256-ranked balanced allocation within calibration or powered blocks
randomization.faceBAllocation: three independent dialogues per world-by-register cell

calibration.rescopeReason: Revision 5 prospectively separates endpoint validity from secondary delivery-style diagnostics. Revision 4 showed that conjoining post-hoc action and register fidelity with endpoint usability caused calibration failure on fields that are not needed to determine the public-transcript engagement endpoint. Revision 5 retains safety, determinate prohibited-delivery absence, persona fidelity, primary outcome coverage, and primary reader agreement as validity gates. Registered action delivery is instead checked before the intervention becomes public, with one repair and a typed retained non-delivery disposition on both faces. Post-hoc action and register fidelity remain fully reported but do not determine endpoint measurability. This re-scope does not recode, rescue, or pool any revision-4 row.
calibration.killRule: Stop before a powered run if execution accounting, pre-public tutor delivery, runtime safety, persona fidelity, determinate prohibited-delivery absence, primary-endpoint determinacy, or primary endpoint-reader eligibility and exact agreement fails on either face. Retain every row. Report-only diagnostics never filter, recode, repair, rerun, replace, or select outcomes. Indeterminate means stop the unit and retain it.

preflight.beforeCalibration: Mint and validate every rival DAG for both faces, free-compile every world-by-register scene on bare and due-clue variants, check every declared CLI reader endpoint, and execute one bounded zero-call stub-transport smoke per role.

dispositions.measurementIndeterminate: retain; stop the unit; no repair, rerun, replacement, or recoding
dispositions.technicalFailure: halt the calibration before starting another unit
dispositions.tutorNonDelivery: retain; stop the unit; never score or determine a rung; never charge the learner; no rerun or replacement
dispositions.tutorDiscriminatingQuestionNonDelivery: retain; stop the unit; never score or determine a rung; never charge the learner; no rerun or replacement

callAuthority.launchRequirement: One attended invocation with TTY-only typed operator approval recorded in approval.json.
callAuthority.provenance: Record source commit, source tree, and dirty flag in plan.json; do not enforce source or design byte pins.
